# Hale Path Packaging
> Custom boxes and packaging solutions — wholesale eco-friendly packaging for businesses. Serving USA, UK, Canada, and Europe.

## Key pages
- [Home](https://www.halepathpackaging.com/): Overview of all Packaging solutions — Offset Printing, Corrugated Packaging, Flexible Packaging, Print & Advertising
- [Products](https://www.halepathpackaging.com/products): All product categories and packaging types
- [About Us](https://www.halepathpackaging.com/about-us): Company story, R&D, production facility, logistics
- [Blog](https://www.halepathpackaging.com/blog): Packaging insights and industry articles
- [Get a Quote](https://www.halepathpackaging.com/get-quote-now): Request custom packaging pricing
- [Contact Us](https://www.halepathpackaging.com/contact-us): Get in touch with the sales team

## Product categories
- [Offset Printing](https://www.halepathpackaging.com/category/offset-printing): High-quality offset printed boxes and packaging
- [Corrugated Packaging](https://www.halepathpackaging.com/category/corrugated): Durable corrugated boxes for shipping and storage
- [Flexible Packaging](https://www.halepathpackaging.com/category/flexible-packaging): Mylar bags and flexible packaging solutions
- [Print & Advertising](https://www.halepathpackaging.com/category/print-advertising): Business printing and promotional materials
- [Branded Finishes](https://www.halepathpackaging.com/category/branded-finishes): Specialty finishes like foiling, embossing, Spot UV
